theme_and_archetype.description: A premium, boutique Brazilian travel agency. Combines the warmth and organic feel of a tropical palette with the high-end, high-contrast, text-rich layout of editorial luxury.

rules.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter font-light leading-none

rules.cta: Use Warm Orange (#E97826) for primary CTAs like 'Solicitar Orçamento'. Text on this button must be Cream (#F5F1E6) or White.
rules.borders: Use Gold Accent (#C9A85A) at 30-50% opacity for borders and dividers.
rules.background: Do not use stark white for the main background. Stick to Cream (#F5F1E6).
rules.contact_section: Use Deep Navy Blue (#12305A) as the background for the Contact section, with Cream (#F5F1E6) text to create a dramatic, luxurious conclusion.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Optical Alignment, Editorial Grids.
layout_and_spacing.hero: Full screen (min-h-screen) with a stunning background image, overlay bg-[#12305A]/30 for text contrast. Left-aligned typography for a premium editorial look. Large H1 text.
layout_and_spacing.destinations_grid: Bento or asymmetric grid. Avoid perfectly equal squares. Mix col-span-1 and col-span-2 to create visual interest. Go cardless or use a very subtle gold border. Generous gap (gap-8 or gap-12).
layout_and_spacing.about_section: Editorial storytelling layout. Large typography on the left, overlapping images on the right. High use of negative space.
layout_and_spacing.contact_section: Dark mode section (bg-[#12305A] text-[#F5F1E6]). Gold borders. Huge typography for contact details.

components_instructions.navigation: Sticky top nav. Background must be transparent with backdrop-blur-xl and a subtle border-b border-white/20 over the hero, transitioning to solid Cream (#F5F1E6) with Deep Navy text upon scrolling past the hero.
components_instructions.buttons: Flat design with 0px or 2px max rounded corners (no pill buttons). Hover state should transition to a deeper shade of orange or navy, with slight scale (-translate-y-0.5).
components_instructions.filters: Horizontal list of chips for destination filtering (Praia, Aventura, etc.). Active filter has bg-[#12305A] text-[#F5F1E6]. Inactive is bg-transparent text-[#12305A] border border-[#C9A85A].
components_instructions.cards: For destinations: Image taking 70% of card height, 30% text below. Use Fraunces for the destination title. Include starting price and 'Solicitar Orçamento' button.
components_instructions.floating_whatsapp: Fixed bottom-right. Tropical Green (#2F7A3B) background. Z-index 50. Must include a pulse animation.
components_instructions.social_links: Use lucide-react for minimal, thin-lined icons (Instagram, Facebook, Mail).

motion.entrances: Staggered fade-up (opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0) for grid items using Framer Motion.
motion.hover: Image scale (1.05) inside a container with overflow-hidden.

hero.description: Luxury tropical resort pool with palms
